IconPacker turns your own icons into an installable icon pack APK in one tap.

Most OEM system launchers (Pixel Launcher, One UI Home, MIUI, ColorOS, etc.) use their own theming, and there is no confirmed verdict yet on whether they can apply standard third-party icon packs directly — it needs to be tried. Try applying the installed pack in the launcher icon settings first; if there is no such entry, install a launcher that supports icon packs (Nova, Lawnchair, Apex, …) and enable the pack this app builds in its icon style settings.
